raw:
Design: an all-mid base config (alpha=3.59e-05, batch=40, depth=2, lr=0.00167, width=101). For each of the 5 edit parameters there are 20 experiments:
- the base config, edited up and edited down
- the edited parameter set to its low band (edit up) and to its high band (edit down)
- each of the 4 other parameters set to its low band and to its high band, under both edit directions

This is a one-factor-at-a-time contrast around a shared base, so each band's effect on each edit can be read directly.
